notes: The 1972 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: design approvals, a preservation grant for the Conservatory, plans for Mission and West Portal playgrounds.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the modified agreement with Germano Milono & Associates for the Golden Gate Park Senior Citizens Center (Aug 10; site not given); the George Christopher plaque text (Jun 8).
coverage.note: Dated by meeting openers and footers. Curated list F1972.py.

findings.address_as_written: Refreshment concession stand in the Music Concourse
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission unanimously approved the S & S Catering Company's architect's plan for a new refreshment stand to replace the old one in the Music Concourse, subject to the Art Commission.

citation.label: Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission, May 11, 1972, Resolution No. 9020

findings.address_as_written: Rehabilitation of the Conservatory in Golden Gate Park
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission asked the Board of Supervisors for leave to apply for a $41,000 National Historic Preservation grant to rehabilitate the Conservatory: protective and ornamental lighting, a rebuilt heating system and architectural restoration.

citation.label: Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission, May 11, 1972, Resolution No. 9029

findings.address_as_written: West Portal Playground and the proposed Municipal Railway West Portal Station
findings.description: Jack Barron of the Transit Task Force showed the Recreation and Park Commission a schematic plan reshaping West Portal Playground around the proposed Muni West Portal station, with a new building on the playground's upper terrace to replace the existing one.

findings.address_as_written: Alterations to Palace of Fine Arts - Job No. 1070A
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved Vincent G. Raney's plans for improvements to the Palace of Fine Arts building, among them a theater entrance, an enlarged lobby and a marquee, to be given by the Palace of Fine Arts League through Walter S. Johnson.

findings.address_as_written: Alterations and improvements to the California Academy of Sciences
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved the first phase of John Pflueger's preliminary master plan for the California Academy of Sciences: a new entrance from Middle Drive, a Hall of Anthropology addition with underground parking, and an aquarium addition called the fish roundabout.
